title: Design agent invariants project from one executable authority
statement: Generated design-agent manifests and design-governance audits project their invariant list from canon/invariants.jsonl; no second executable design-invariant list is permitted.

invariants.statement: Product source uses Inter and Satoshi only; serif media requires an exact approved exception.
Marketing pills are 32px visible inside a 44px minimum hit target.
The marketing O-mark is visibly 32px and control-aligned.
Accent color communicates semantic state or a named data category, never decoration.
Decorative icons and emoji have no border, ring, circle, or badge plate.
One canonical component family owns a concept; supported states are variants consumed as instances.
Founder review contains canonical masters and intentional variants, without receipts, duplicates, or filler.
Pen is proposal/review evidence until source identity and required persistence receipts pass.
Logos normalize visible non-transparent ink through the shared asset registry, never route-local crop or scale CSS.
Never crop album art. Use object-fit: contain, not cover. No gradient, overlay, play button, or chrome on album art, merch, or a face except optional mostly-transparent glass play/pause.

title: Changed screens require external screen-certification/v2 evidence
statement: Every changed user-visible screen-like path on web, macOS Electron, and iOS must have typed ownership registration or an explicit allowed exclusion. title: Hard PR blockers close through bounded autonomous remediation
statement: Every hard pull-request blocker is actively classified and repaired: clean-behind branches use exact-head mechanical update, true same-repository conflicts escalate to bounded smarter-model FX on GitHub-hosted runners, and every non-force push requires a fresh exact head and base reread. Concurrency adapts through 2, 10, and 40-PR cohorts from runner availability, CI saturation, latency, stale-head skips, backlog, remediation success, and durable cohort receipts, with immediate backoff on degradation. Bounded exhaustion is terminal for an unchanged exact head/base pair and emits a typed steering exception; a changed pair starts a fresh bounded lease automatically. Human taste or steering occurs before a shipping PR opens or in an independently shippable follow-up PR and never adds a hold to the current shipping PR.

title: Writer proof owns autonomous PR promotion
statement: An autonomous pull request remains draft until its owning writer emits exact-head author-owned proof for required tests, review sweep, ticket evidence, and PR evidence; that same writer action must pair ready-for-review with native auto-merge or merge-queue intent for the exact head, and any failed enrollment restores or leaves draft with one terminal writer-attributed blocker. Reconciliation is observer/recovery-only and cannot manufacture missing proof or hide writer failure. New workflow or controller hops are rejected unless they carry a bounded trust-boundary or capability-gap exception with one accountable writer and a concrete removal or revisit trigger.

title: Fleet observation gaps and non-main PR bases must not freeze shipping
statement: A production-bound green main SHA remains drainable when Main Release Ready is missing from flooded commit check-runs or the queue snapshot 502s; the gate must read the CI workflow job and must not treat needs-human, hold, or gated as enrollment blockers. A queue snapshot gap never freezes shipping, including when production is unbound (hold-intake continues). Every open PR targets main: stacked bases fail closed and drain retargets strays. GraphQL 502 is a retry, not ineligibility. Graphite and Cursor GitHub apps are removed; native GitHub merge queue is the only landing transport.

title: Continuous quality ratchet governs every capability
statement: Quality is a continuously governed first-class objective: every registered capability or interaction class owns a versioned QualityContract in canon/quality-contracts.jsonl with all eight quality dimensions, measurement sources, targets, hard floors, observed values, last-known-good certified baselines, containment policy, ownership, certification requirements, expiring exceptions, and evidence links; shipping may not silently lower the floor; detection deterministically produces containment, prioritized work, verification, and baseline update; when no higher-value objective work exists Summer pulls the highest expected-value bounded quality improvement with a falsifiable hypothesis, guardrails, and rollback, and ratchets the baseline only on material evidenced net improvement without offsetting regressions.
